data_description.verify_ssl: Disabled by default because many local KentixONE systems use a self-signed certificate. Enable it when the Kentix certificate is trusted by Home Assistant.

data_description.scan_interval: Time between safety reconciliations through GET /api/systemvalues. Default: 300 seconds. Valid managed webhooks apply switching states immediately; this interval updates normal MultiSensor values and repairs missed events. Choose a lower value for more frequent environmental updates.
data_description.manage_webhook: Creates one active, uniquely named webhook in KentixONE. Switching states and alarm counters are applied directly from a validated payload; unknown payloads still trigger an API reconciliation. Other webhooks are never modified.
data_description.show_access_managers: Disabled by default. AccessManagers are technical controllers for access control and DoorLocks. Hiding them removes only the AccessManager device and its own measurements; DoorLocks, alarm groups, and their controls remain fully visible. Enable this option to expose the AccessManager itself with its connectivity and diagnostic measurements.

init.description: Managed webhooks update alarm groups immediately. The system-values interval is a safety reconciliation and updates continuously changing MultiSensor values. Inventory is read at most every four hours.
init.title: Kentix options
